scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @skullking/server" "npm run dev -w @skullking/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @skullking/shared && npm run build -w @skullking/server && npm run build -w @skullking/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @skullking/shared && npm run typecheck -w @skullking/server && npm run typecheck -w @skullking/web
